article_context: The body image illustrates the section explaining why Arkhyz cable cars are a comfortable, safe, and family-friendly way to explore the mountains. Its editorial focus is the smooth enclosed-gondola ride through coniferous forest toward panoramic peaks, reinforced locally by information about child fares and convenient advance ticket purchase.
image_reading: A wide summer mountain view shows several enclosed gondola cabins suspended above a dense coniferous forest, with the cable line rising toward distant partly snow-covered peaks.
The nearest cabins and the ascending cable route are the clearest movable elements; the cabins are already aligned for smooth travel along the cable.
The open sky, forested slope, and visible mountain destination emphasize a calm scenic ascent rather than speed or thrill.

models.positive_prompt: The enclosed gondola cabins glide smoothly uphill along the cables at a steady gentle speed. Keep the camera fixed and the cabins continuously visible; by the final frame, the nearest cabin has advanced clearly toward the next support tower while the calm ascent continues.
models.scene_plan: Five-second fixed wide shot focused on the cable line. The visible gondola cabins begin moving immediately and maintain a gentle, even uphill glide through the forest. Their displacement remains moderate and easy to track, with the nearest cabin approaching the next support tower in the final frames while all cabins stay enclosed, recognizable, and aligned with the cable.

models.positive_prompt: Gondola cabins travel steadily uphill above the forest as the camera makes a slow forward push toward the ascending cable line. End with the nearest cabin noticeably closer to the support tower, still gliding smoothly toward the peaks.
models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, the cabins progress smoothly uphill for most of the shot while a single restrained forward camera push follows the cable route toward the mountain. The motion stays calm and continuous, emphasizing an effortless scenic ride. Near the end, the foreground cabin is visibly closer to the next tower and remains in motion, with the cable system and mountainward direction clear.

models.positive_prompt: The gondola cabins glide gently uphill along the cable while the camera slowly tracks forward toward the nearest moving cabin. In the last frame, it is visibly nearer the support tower and continues its calm ascent above the forest.
models.scene_plan: A focused four-second ascent with slightly smaller travel distance: the nearest gondola and the cabins behind it move at a steady gentle pace while one slow forward camera track keeps the nearest cabin as the focal target. The endpoint arrives near the end when that cabin has clearly advanced toward the support tower, remaining fully visible and securely aligned on the cable.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: A gondola ride at Arkhyz offers families a calm, comfortable, and scenic way to reach the mountain heights.
structured_intent.primary_action: The enclosed gondola cabins glide uphill along the cable above the forest.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The ride remains smooth, secure, and reassuring throughout, with the enclosed cabins visibly supported by the cable system.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The nearest visible cabin has progressed noticeably closer to the next support tower while continuing uphill.
